comment: The agent manifest. A static host cannot list a directory, so this file IS the directory listing: add a folder under public/agents/ and add its name here, or the app will never fetch it. Order is irrelevant; the loader sorts by name. Three entries, and only one of them is an agent you talk to: `main` is the assistant, and `summarizer` and `critic` are machinery — found by the `role:` they declare, called by the loop rather than by a model, and never offered as tools.
